text: Information and Communication Engineering is an interdisciplinary subject that studies information transmission, processing, exchange and application, integrating fields such as electronic science and technology, computer science and control science. Its core task is to solve the problem of "how to efficiently and reliably transmit information", involving the full-chain technology from the underlying hardware design to the upper-layer network protocol. Typical applications include 5G communication, satellite remote sensing, artificial intelligence signal processing, etc.
